description: Returns the signed-in account's template requests (sent with request_template or the contact form's template-request topic), newest first, each with its id, date, the first 200 characters of the request and its status: received (in the team's inbox, not reviewed yet) or reviewed (the team has handled it; search for new templates to see what shipped). Pass id to look up one request. Use this to follow up on a request instead of sending it again. Read-only; only the account's own requests are visible. Requires sign-in.

id.description: One request id, as returned by request_template. Omit to list recent requests.

limit.description: How many recent requests to return when id is omitted, 1 to 50 (default 10).

name: get_request_status
title: Get template request status
